1	/**
2	 * Scoped per testing.md: this organism's own contract (given a variation + props, does it render
3	 * the right children with the right flags, and does every interactive control still fire its own
4	 * callback) — not ZimmProductCardMedia/ZimmProductCardContent's own internal logic, which is
5	 * already proven in their own index.test.tsx files. Both are composed for real here (not mocked
6	 * out), the same "costs nothing, gives real integration confidence" precedent
7	 * zimmProductCardContent/index.test.tsx already documents for its own composed atoms/molecules.
8	 *
9	 * Only `useMultiStyleConfig` is mocked, with one flat object covering every part every composed
10	 * descendant reads (`ZimmProductCardMedia`, `ZimmSlideIndicator`, `ZimmProductCardContent`,
11	 * `ZimmProductPrice`, `ZimmSizeChipGroup`, `ZimmSizeChip`, and this organism's own `root`) — same
12	 * "neither test setup nor Chakra cares which recipe name asked for it" precedent
13	 * zimmProductCardMedia/index.test.tsx documents. `ZimmProductName`'s `useStyleConfig` call is left
14	 * real/unmocked, same as zimmProductCardContent/index.test.tsx.
15	 */
16	import React from 'react';
17	import { describe, test, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
18	import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
19	import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
20	import { chakra } from '@chakra-ui/react';
21	import { IntlProvider } from 'react-intl';
22	import { MemoryRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
23	import { ZimmProductCard } from './index';
24	import type {
25	  ZimmProductCardProps,
26	  ZimmProductCardImage,
27	  ZimmProductCardBaseProps,
28	  ZimmProductCardPlpVariation,
29	  ZimmProductCardHomeVariation,
30	  ZimmProductCardWishlistVariation,
31	} from './index';
32	import { ZimmProductCard as ZimmProductCardRecipe } from './zimmProductCard.css';
33	// Fix 1 (Scorer rework round 1): needed to compose the REAL close-part style object this
34	// organism's root recipe cascades against — see the "Fix 1" describe block below. `chakra` above
35	// is imported the normal way (not via vi.importActual) because the vi.mock('@chakra-ui/react', ...)
36	// factory below spreads `...actual` and only overrides `useMultiStyleConfig` — `chakra` itself
37	// was never mocked, so this import already resolves to the real Emotion-backed factory.
38	import { ZimmProductCardMedia as ZimmProductCardMediaRecipe } from '../../molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/zimmProductCardMedia.css';
39	// Fix D: the real `breakpoints.md` value, so DESKTOP_QUERY below can't drift from the source
40	// file's own derivation of it. No DOM-level compose-and-read proof for this one (unlike Fix 1/3/
41	// C above) — those all resolve a STATIC declaration; jsdom's actual support for resolving a real
42	// `min-width` media query against getComputedStyle is unreliable enough that the object-shape
43	// assertions below, plus the real-browser check every hover/pointer concern in this file's own
44	// "KNOWN LIMITATION" docblock already defers to, are the honest level of proof here.
45	import { breakpoints } from 'app/theme/foundation';
46	import { CARD_SLOT, HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY } from '../../zimmProductCardShared';
47	
48	/**
49	 * Fix G's own contribution is a boolean `index.tsx` COMPUTES (`bagHiddenOnMobile`, combining two
50	 * VARIATION_CONFIG fields with `isUnavailable`) before ever calling `useMultiStyleConfig` — the
51	 * "real recipe assertions" pattern used everywhere else in this file proves the RECIPE reacts
52	 * correctly to a given `hideBagOnMobile` value, but says nothing about whether index.tsx computed
53	 * the right value in the first place. `vi.hoisted` lets this mock factory (hoisted above the rest
54	 * of the file by Vitest) share a capture slot with the test body below, without hitting a TDZ
55	 * error from referencing an un-hoisted `let`.
56	 */
57	const { capturedOrganismStyleProps } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
58	  capturedOrganismStyleProps: { current: undefined as Record<string, unknown> | undefined },
59	}));
